subject.title: [Feature Request]: Native Prompt Caching Support for Amazon Nova (Bedrock)

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally enable native prompt caching for direct Amazon Bedrock Nova models, changing them from forced no-cache to cache-point eligible behavior?
rationale: Source and AWS docs support the request, but shipping it changes provider request shaping and billing/cache defaults for existing Nova users and still needs live Bedrock proof.

options.title: Land after live Nova proof
options.body: Require redacted Converse or ConverseStream proof, then land the linked provider-owned fix or a narrow refreshed replacement.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Preserve forced no-cache as the upgrade default and allow Nova cache points only through an explicit setting or narrower policy gate.

options.title: Defer Nova caching
options.body: Leave current no-cache behavior in place until maintainers have stronger live provider evidence or ownership capacity.

recommendation.title: Land after live Nova proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted Converse or ConverseStream proof, then land the linked provider-owned fix or a narrow refreshed replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Bedrock prompt-cache history makes this the strongest available routing signal for the provider behavior decision.
